question: The National Sports Festival for Women was started in __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1975**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** National Sports Festival for Women was started in 1975** as part of the celebration of International Women's Year by the Government of India to boost women's participation in games and sports.
 
• The festival emerged during the **International Women's Year**, which the United Nations declared in 1975, emphasizing gender equality and women's empowerment globally.
 
• **Objectives** 
 
 
• To encourage more women to take up sports and make it a part of their daily lives.
 
• To discover talented female athletes who could represent India in national and international competitions.
 
• To discover talented female athletes who could represent India in national and international competitions.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Sports Day in India is celebrated on August 29.
 
• National Sports Day was included in the list of celebratory days in India for the first time in 2012.
 
• The National Sports Day is celebrated to commemorate the birth anniversary of hockey legend Dhyan Chand Singh.
 
• The government has also used this day as a platform to launch various sports schemes, including the Khelo India movement, which was announced by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in 2018.
 
• The National Sports Day is also an occasion that sees the nation honour its sporting heroes with recognitions like the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna, Arjuna Award, Dhyan Chand Award and the Dronacharya Award.
 
• At a special ceremony held at the Rashtrapati Bhavan, the President of India takes this day to confer these awards.
